title: A Single-Loop Penalty-based Algorithm for Stochastic Minimax Optimization with Nonlinear Coupled Constraints
summary: We study stochastic nonconvex-concave minimax optimization with nonlinear coupled constraints that are convex in the maximization variable. To address the nonsmoothness arising from such constraints, we develop a penalty-based smooth approximation that combines quadratic penalization of the coupled constraints with quadratic regularization of the inner maximization problem. Based on this approximation, we propose SPACO, a single-loop stochastic gradient algorithm that tracks the inner maximizer by one stochastic ascent step, updates the outer variable using an inexact stochastic descent…
